title: piptocarpha oblonga var. lepidota

The health benefits of Piptocarpha oblonga var. lepidota include its potential use in the treatment of various ailments, such as fever, cough, and respiratory issues. The plant has been found to exhibit therapeutic actions including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antifungal properties, making it a valuable source of natural remedies. The bioactive constituents of Piptocarpha oblonga var. lepidota include sesquiterpene lactones, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential in the development of new medicines.
